items.summary: Says that as Lieutenant Governor she will make higher education and college more affordable.
items.title: Make higher education more affordable

citations.quote: As Lieutenant Governor, I will make higher education more affordable, expand paid internships, and strengthen career pathways.
I’ll work to make college more affordable and ensure seniors can age with dignity.
